title: InventorLoader route and admission reconciliation
mode: Deeper/broader current primary-source and issue review; existing evidence reconciliation

localScope.head: de27a33
localScope.worktreeState: The worktree was already broadly modified and uncommitted. This research pass edited the parity plan and its 3D-plan summary and created two research receipts; no prior or unrelated work was staged or committed.

sources.observation: The DXF route uses ezdxf to read entities and extract their SAT/SAB bytes, then passes the data to the add-on's own AcisReader (readText/readBinary). The shape builder resolves ACIS body/lump/shell/face/wire records and constructs FreeCAD/OCCT Part objects. Its visible face path emits Part.Shell(faces) and can fall back to individual faces; this is not by itself evidence of a closed Part.Solid. The STEP/Part results for exact payloads are already recorded in the 3D plan. The README lists no SAT/SAB/DXF export and unsupported blending surfaces, some helix surfaces, and law-defined geometry without spline data.
sources.planDisposition: Keep SCREENED_NOT_ADMITTED. Reuse the existing commit-pinned, exact-payload STEP/Part witness without another run. Native shell/face/wire builder, STEP conversion, standalone SAT import, and DXF wrapper are distinct routes. A future changed-route check requires immutable source/runtime pinning and source-wide input-safety/resource review first.

sources.observation: A public report against FreeCAD weekly 1.1.0 development build commit 5e4fe3a3c3af46be530969d323368fee8bfcba3b and InventorLoader 1.5.1 describes a native DXF import KeyError and an empty result from the STEP strategy on one 3D-DXF. The issue is version- and case-specific and has not been independently reproduced in this research.
sources.planDisposition: Keep as a version- and case-specific failure report, not a contradiction of the historical pinned witness, libdxfrw defect, or universal current failure. Do not rerun unchanged payloads.

sources.observation: Open report says a SAB import/conversion of an attached CONTENT_3D.zip fails with TypeError: sequence item 1; expected str instance, int found. The issue does not pin source revision, complete runtime, input hash/profile, or an independently checked geometry expectation.
sources.planDisposition: Record as an unresolved peer failure shape only. Do not download or commit the attachment. It neither establishes a libdxfrw defect nor invalidates narrow historical exact-payload results.

sources.observation: Open report describes a FreeCAD 1.2 user's difficulty importing the demo Dice.sat and includes a standalone workaround using AcisReader, ezdxf's experimental OpenSCAD route, and STEP/Part. It is not an independently reproduced fix or pinned source change.
sources.planDisposition: Keep standalone SAT import and the posted workaround separate from the DXF add-on branches. Reopen only if a new exact route question is posed; record default route and workaround separately.

sources.observation: Stock FreeCAD documentation states that the built-in DXF importers do not read embedded ACIS solids. InventorLoader is a separate add-on route; its DXF side delegates envelope/entity parsing to ezdxf and it does not read DWG AcDs sections or verify group-320 owner/key joins.
sources.planDisposition: Do not count the add-on as stock FreeCAD native support, as an independent DWG decoder, or as ACDSDATA join evidence. It can be used after exact local carrier/association checks to inspect the extracted SAT/SAB body.

sources.observation: OpenCADKernel describes an ACIS-to-project-B-rep feature but labels itself early, says most operations are not written, and documents opencadcodec as its ACIS dependency. It is not a currently available qualified external semantic route.
sources.planDisposition: Keep as NOT_READY/future candidate; do not wait for it or count it as current evidence.

sources.observation: package.xml declares LGPL-3.0-or-later while the repository LICENSE contains GPL version 2 text. This review does not establish the intended grant or per-file provenance; master was not pinned to a commit in this pass.
sources.planDisposition: No source is copied, bundled, or distributed. Resolve provenance/license before source reuse; treat this as admission uncertainty rather than a legal conclusion about runtime testing.

sources.observation: The current public Acis.py source contains a reachable Law.evaluate path that calls Python eval(self.eq). This research did not execute the add-on or perform a complete taint/resource audit.
sources.planDisposition: Before giving any new input to a future run, pin the complete source tree and audit parser reachability, expression construction, file writes, subprocess/network use, bounds, and resource exhaustion. Until then, leave this route NOT_RUN/SCREENED_NOT_ADMITTED.

existingOwnersRefined: PAR-07/S8: external semantic reader route and evidence ceiling
PAR-59: staged raw-carrier to shape-construction loss attribution

sequence: Reuse the already recorded immutable InventorLoader commit and exact payload hashes/outcomes; do not rerun the three SABs or create a duplicate generated payload/CTest.
Keep the historical STEP/Part witness separate from the current native shell/face/wire route, standalone SAT import, stock FreeCAD DXF path, and dwg2dxf handoff.

The existing 2026-10-20 two-prism, scratch-generated profile remains the sole optional new candidate probe; do not repeat the old exact payloads or add another control. Run it only after a materially changed source/runtime/profile question is pinned, or to investigate a specific issue reproducer. First pin complete source SHA, FreeCAD/Python/ezdxf/OCCT, OS/architecture, and license/provenance disposition.

Before any new input, audit the reachable eval path, file writes, subprocess/network behavior, bounds, and resource limits. If the safety gate is incomplete, mark NOT_RUN and continue local implementation.

If later admitted, use only scratch-generated analytic controls; record exact hash/profile, parser exceptions and unknowns, body reachability, fallbacks, shape type/validity/closure, units/placement/bounds, and independently expected analytic metrics.
Keep the entity-handle to group-320 key to payload association independent; InventorLoader does not read DWG AcDs or qualify the outer join.
Self-unblock absent runtimes, unsupported profiles, failed peer routes, and platform gaps as NOT_RUN/NOT_QUALIFIED; do not wait for this optional route.
implementationReadiness.evidenceCeiling: The old exact-payload STEP/Part results remain historical same-OCCT-family semantic observations, not current-add-on qualification. No route here independently proves the DWG AcDs join, stock FreeCAD importer behavior, arbitrary SAT/SAB coverage, kernel-independent geometry, or native dwg2dxf interoperability.

limitations: No external drawing or issue attachment was downloaded, no fixture was created, and no FreeCAD/add-on runtime, peer executable, geometry kernel, or native CAD application was run. Current master source was not pinned; public docs/issues are screening evidence only. The historical exact-payload run remains separately recorded. J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
